definitions.explanation: Suffix attached to nouns to indicate a shop or store that sells that item.

definitions.gloss: dealer, seller, person in that trade
definitions.explanation: Can also refer to the person who runs such a shop or works in that trade.

examples.japanese: ⟦{花|はな}{屋|や}→花屋：03136_hanaya⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦きれいな→きれい：00717_kirei⟧⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought beautiful flowers at the flower shop.
I want to go to the bookstore.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{不動産|ふどうさん}→不動産：06726_fudousan⟧{屋|や}⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: That person is a real estate agent.
There is a bakery and a cake shop near the station.

examples.japanese: ⟦{魚|さかな}{屋|や}→魚屋：14642_sakanaya⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦おじさん→おじさん：00803_ojisan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧⟦{元気|げんき}→元気：00696_genki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きい→大きい：00335_ookii⟧。
examples.english: The man at the fish shop is always energetic and loud.

examples.japanese: ⟦うち→うち：27540_uchi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{近所|きんじょ}→近所：01318_kinjo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{肉|にく}{屋|や}→肉屋：15233_nikuya⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{続|つづ}いて→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦{老舗|しにせ}→老舗：16152_shinise⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: The butcher shop in our neighborhood is a long-established store that has been going since my grandfather's time.

notes:
COMMON SHOP NAMES:
- ⟦{本|ほん}{屋|や}→本屋：03034_honya⟧ (bookstore)
- ⟦{花|はな}{屋|や}→花屋：03136_hanaya⟧ (florist, flower shop)
- ⟦{肉|にく}{屋|や}→肉屋：15233_nikuya⟧ (butcher, meat shop)
- ⟦{魚|さかな}{屋|や}→魚屋：14642_sakanaya⟧ (fish shop, fishmonger)
- ⟦{八百|やお}{屋|や}→八百屋：02978_yaoya⟧ (vegetable shop, greengrocer)
- ⟦{酒|さか}{屋|や}→酒屋：14436_sakaya⟧ (liquor store)
- ⟦{薬|くすり}{屋|や}→薬屋：noentry⟧ (pharmacy, drugstore)
- ⟦{電気|でんき}{屋|や}→電気屋：noentry⟧ (electronics store)
- ⟦{不動産|ふどうさん}→不動産：06726_fudousan⟧{屋|や} (real estate agency)
- ⟦パン{屋|や}→パン屋：19415_panya⟧ (bakery)

NOTE: More formal word for store is ⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧ or 〜⟦{店|てん}→店：10011_ten⟧. The suffix {屋|や} has a more traditional or casual feel.

ALSO MEANS: When added to words describing character or behavior, can indicate a person of that type: ⟦{恥|は}ずかし{屋|や}→恥ずかし屋：noentry⟧ (shy person), ⟦{寂|さび}し{屋|や}→寂し屋：noentry⟧ (lonely person).
